name: every-other-token (LLM token confidence)
description: Installs every-other-token, a CLI that intercepts an OpenAI or Anthropic stream and shows how confident the model was about each token, from logprobs. A mock provider needs no API key.

version.description: Release to install, e.g. 1.2.2. 'latest' follows the newest GitHub release of Mattbusel/Every-Other-Token.
